Brent 1-2, 2-3, 3-4

Prompt Brent timespreads are not as steep as the 2-3 or 3-4. Market is still working through some of the flows that came out from the June MOU, but you can see the latter months are showing a tighter market. 

If we see Fujairah get choked off, you can expect Brent timespreads to shoot up to the $8-$10 range. Fujairah is the only reason why crude is not moving in the same fashion as diesel.
